body:
I searched the internet and couldn't find any specific information on the dosage of this drug, however I DID find the only  experience report on barbiturates talked about butalibital/apap, so I knew it was possible to attain some sort of intoxication on these pills, however I feared the potentital repercussions, seeing that whole experience just talked about the death of the author's liver thanks to the said substance.
So, I decided to experiment.  I figured if I started with the reccomended dose (1 pill), them waited and noted effects for a while, I could then take another if I felt it was necessary.  I ended up taking 3 and aside from some mild relaxation (which may have been my mind playing tricks on me) and a mild headache for a few minutes (ironic, seeing this IS headache medicine), there were distinguishable effects.
Here is my log I was writing in while taking these shitty pills:
10:35: 1 tablet quala-cet 50mg butalbital/325mg acetominophen/40mg caffiene
Clear mind about test. Feeling healthy, but a bit tired.  Awaiting effects, especially seeing I don't know what/when they will be..
10:38:  feeling kinda 'altered'  definitely the placebo effect.
10:57:  still no distinct effects yet.  Feel a 'pressure' headache, sort of, but not really.  Might be the caffiene, seeing I almost never have caffiene.
11:20:  still no apparent effect.  I'm going to take another...
11:21 : took another one
11:32: some relaxation, maybe
11:34 :  somewhat altered feeling in head kinda, like almost being high, I guess... I suck at describing shit.
11:35:  definintely something kicking in.  I can feel myself relaxing and pain is fading away.  I don't really want to sit up any more
11:38:  kinda clumsy, kinda hard time making sense in sentences, more relaxed, want more
11:46  nothing more, but I want to take another, but I'll wait another 10 or 15 minutes atleast...
11:53:  almost 15 minutes...
11:57:  slight dry/sore throat.  Kinda like when on amphetamines
12:01:  I think I'm going to take another...
12:02  yup, took another... Still no distinguishable feelings, aside from that temporary relaxation
12:04 heart pain, which happens sometimes, but scared the fuck outta me
12:05 I want to be high, but not really feeling much
12:44:  still ain't really feeling shit.  Kinda uncoordinated at times and forgetful and relaxed, but probably all in my mind...
12:56 :  dangit
9:17:  no effects that I really noticed.  Perhaps I should have taken more, but I'm not planning on it....
Please note, if you haven't noticed already, I don't really structure my sentences too well because I'm a lazy fuck and I use ellipses (...) quite frequently. These weren't caused by the drug, this is a normal behavior of mine.  Even analyzing the text after the experience, I can see that my mind was barely altered, if it was at all.
In conclusion, it's pretty obvious I still have no clue how much I should have taken.  Due to the apap, I must limit my intake so its level never goes too high, seeing how it's very hard on your liver and toxic at high levels.  I could have easily taken a lot more regardless.  The dosage information I did find on barbiturates
, said that most of them are taken in ranges of 30-250mg either at a time, or daily.  Which one of those it is depends upon whether it is a short, intermediate, or long acting barb.  Butalbital is an intermediate.  I don't think I'll try these again, unless I get some solid information on dosing and such.
